Frederick Stone
Harmony Games

input.body:
Leonard,

Done. Everyone who was waiting has a written answer, each company's contact is in Contacts, and the full log is in the Q4 commitments folder ("Q4 commitments log", one row per company, columns from the README): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/c52f220e850d6979/edit

What we're keeping (Arthur's keep-running list):
- Vaultline: nightly DB backups move to Standard, $19/month from the Oct 12 renewal
- Certwell: API domain SSL cert, $89/year, renews before Oct 20
- Pingwise (the night pager): moves to Team, $29/month from Nov 1

Waiting on you to sign:
- Kinetic Arcade: Japan/Korea publishing LOI for Zombie Match 3D (12 months' exclusivity). With ESG first; needs signing by Oct 20
- Bundlehouse: holiday bundle participation agreement (licenses Domino Delights' name and art). With ESG first; needed by Nov 1
- Orbit Store: November featuring agreement, no fees, accepted in their partner portal by Oct 24

Waiting on Arthur to sign:
- Lumencloud: Startup Program agreement for $25k credits (36-month term). With ESG first; cohort closes Oct 31
- Playfuse: mutual NDA on our template, before their Oct 8 call (no ESG review needed)
- Markward: free-tier click-through terms in their dashboard (no deadline; they're holding the setup)

I sent each of the three ESG ones to ESG Law intake as its own email, using your checklist. All six have cards in the To Do list on the Harmony Games board, with the company name in the card title.

The rest, in short:
- Ended (would cost cash before January), and each one told no: Brightlane, ASO retainer, Clipforge, localization quote, player panel, Bay Area Indie Showcase booth, Framewell Pro, trailer music licence, Seattle Indie Expo, November creator campaign, Spotlight Fest
  - Clipforge's pilot would have turned into $1,800/month on Oct 16. I cancelled it in writing to billing@paylane.io, as their notice asks.
  - Seattle Indie Expo counts as cash because of your Monday change: they would book our travel and bill us for it.
- Parked until the Jan 5 review: Lanternfly, Cloudlark, Pressbeam, Echohall, Hootline, Retainly, Quillcraft, Loopnote, Reviewly, Tilecast, Benchmarkly, the font licence and the voice-over quote. Each one has a reminder on my calendar for Jan 5.
- Already answered: Motive Forge. Arthur passed on Sep 19, so I didn't write to them again.
- Left off the log: Nova Rewards, because they withdrew their offer on Sep 23.

Thanks,
Fred
